description: Hyperliquid standing orders, by `view`. `open`: every order resting at one instant (`at`, default the newest snapshot) for a `symbol` and/or a `wallet`, in key order, each with its owner's `sizeCohort`, `pnlCohort` and `pnlCumUsd` (without `at` the current labels, with `at` those of the hour before the snapshot's own hour), optionally one cohort's, with `snapshotTs` and `source`: `l4_5m` = the node's 5-minute order snapshot (from 2026-10-23 21:45 UTC), `state_12m` = rebuilt from the ~12-minute checkpoints (from 2026-07-29; before the 5-minute feed, or while it is stalled), where short-lived orders can be missing. `wallet`: what became of one wallet's orders in a window, newest placement first: each order seen resting or filled in it, its fills in the window and a `status` (open, filled, partially_filled, canceled_or_expired); `notes` says what a snapshot cannot tell. `clusters`: one symbol's standing orders within `range_pct` of the mid of the best resting bid and ask, bucketed by price (bids and asks by limit price, take-profit and stop-loss by trigger price; trailing stops are not bucketed), optionally one cohort's. `book`: one symbol's order book at one instant, the resting limit orders summed per price (`px`, `sz`, `n` orders), `levels` a side, bids highest first and asks lowest first; `l4_5m` from 2026-11-13 08:40 UTC, `state_12m` from 2026-07-28, and `snapshotTs` is the snapshot's own time. `squeeze`: one perp's price ladder at one instant, per bucket the resting book (size and USD value), the stop orders that would trade into it when triggered and the open positions that would be liquidated into it, and `pressure` = that forced selling over the USD value of the resting bids below the mid, forced buying over the asks above it (above 1: a squeeze); `cohort` keeps one cohort's stops and liquidations. `book_cohorts`: which cohorts own the resting book within `band_bps` of the mid over time, per point and cohort the bid and ask notional and its share, each owner labelled as of that 5-minute snapshot. `open`, `clusters`, `book`, `book_cohorts` and `walls` read the perp books unless `market=spot`. `walls`: the large orders (at least `min_usd`, default $1M; a stop or take-profit at its trigger price) of a `symbol` and/or a `wallet` whose last sighting falls in a window (default the last 24 hours, at most 7 days), newest first, each with `outcome` (`filled`, `partially_filled`, `pulled` = left the book with no fill, `open`, or `unknown` while the fills are not yet stored), `filled_usd`, `lifetime_s`, `near_touch` (the other side of the book within `touch_bps` of its price when it was last seen; null where that snapshot's book is not stored: 5-minute snapshots before 2026-11-13 08:40 UTC) and its owner's labels (current for an open wall, else those of the hour before it was last seen: each row's `label_basis`). `order_stats`: one wallet's walls of at least `min_usd` (default $100k) in a window (default and at most 7 days) in totals and for its 20 busiest symbols: counts per outcome, `pulled_share` (pulled / walls that left the book with a known outcome), `cancel_to_fill_ratio` (pulled / filled), `pulled_near_touch_share` (over its newest 1,000 pulled walls), `median_lifetime_s`, `total_wall_usd` and `filled_usd`. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/orders, /wallets/{address}/orders, /symbols/{symbol}/order-clusters, /symbols/{symbol}/book, /symbols/{symbol}/squeeze-map, /symbols/{symbol}/book-cohorts, /walls and /wallets/{address}/order-stats.

address.description: Hyperliquid wallet address: 0x followed by 40 hex characters, any case. Used by view: wallet, order_stats. Required by view: wallet, order_stats.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant, floored to 5 minutes. Default: the newest snapshot; not before 2026-07-29 (`book`: 2026-07-28), not in the future. On `open` and `clusters` an `at` with no complete 5-minute snapshot is rebuilt from the sightings around it, so short-lived orders can be missing; `book` answers the newest snapshot at or before it, and `squeeze` each of its parts' newest at or before it. Used by view: open, clusters, book, squeeze.

band_bps.description: `book_cohorts`: the orders within `50`, `200` (the default) or `1000` basis points of the mid. Used by view: book_cohorts.

cohort.description: One label on `axis`, spelled exactly as `hl_segments` view=cohorts lists it, e.g. `whale` (size) or `3x smart` (pnl). Only that cohort's orders (`open`, `clusters`), or its stops and liquidations (`squeeze`). Without `at` by the current labels; with `at` by the labels of the hour before the snapshot's own hour, the ones `open` rows carry. Used by view: open, clusters, squeeze.

cohort_axis.description: The ladder `cohort` is read on: `size`, `pnl` or `pnl_abs`. Default `size`. On `book_cohorts` the ladder the book is split by: `size` or `pnl`. Default by view: book_cohorts size. Used by view: open, clusters, squeeze, book_cohorts.

created_from.description: ISO-8601 UTC: only orders placed at or after this. Used by view: open.

created_to.description: ISO-8601 UTC: only orders placed at or before this. Used by view: open.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page. On `open` it pins the snapshot of the first page. Used by view: open, wallet, walls.

from.description: ISO-8601 UTC start of the window. Default: 7 days before `to` (`wallet`, `order_stats`), 24 hours before `to` (`walls`, `book_cohorts`). Used by view: wallet, book_cohorts, walls, order_stats.

interval.description: `book_cohorts`: one point per `5m`, `1h` (the default) or `1d`; hours and days average the 5-minute snapshots. Used by view: book_cohorts.

kind.description: `both` (the default), `resting` (limit orders on the book) or `trigger` (untriggered stops and take-profits). Used by view: walls.

levels.description: Price levels per side, counted from the best price outward. Max 1000. Used by view: book.

limit.description: Rows per page. Max 1000. Used by view: open, wallet, walls.

market.description: `perp` (the default) or `spot`. Perp and spot books are never mixed: HYPE is both. Used by view: open, clusters, book, book_cohorts, walls, order_stats.

min_usd.description: Smallest wall in USD: limit price x original size, a stop or take-profit at its trigger price. At least 100,000. Default by view: walls 1000000.0, order_stats 100000.0. Used by view: walls, order_stats.

oid.description: One order id. 0 (the default) = every order. Used by view: open.

order_type.description: One order type; an unknown value is refused. Used by view: open.

outcome.description: Only the walls with this outcome: `filled`, `partially_filled`, `pulled` (left the book with no fill), `open` (still resting) or `unknown` (left the book, fills not yet stored). Omit for all. Used by view: walls.

range_pct.description: Half-width of the price range around the mid, in percent, at least 1. Default 10 (`clusters`), 8 (`squeeze`). Default by view: clusters 10, squeeze 8. Max 50. Used by view: clusters, squeeze.

side.description: `both` (the default), `bid` or `ask`: which side of the book to return. Used by view: book.

status.description: `open`, `filled`, `partially_filled` or `canceled_or_expired`. Omit for every status. Used by view: wallet.

step_bps.description: Bucket width in basis points of the mid, at least 1. Default 10 (`clusters`), 25 (`squeeze`). Default by view: clusters 10, squeeze 25. Max 500. Used by view: clusters, squeeze.

symbol.description: Hyperliquid instrument ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, HYPE; a HIP-3 market is `dex:TICKER`, e.g. xyz:TSLA. With `market=spot` a spot pair, `HYPE/USDC` (a bare `HYPE` is `HYPE/USDC`). On `open` and `walls`, `symbol` and/or `wallet` is required: an unfiltered snapshot is the whole book. Used by view: open, wallet, clusters, book, squeeze, book_cohorts, walls. Required by view: clusters, book, squeeze, book_cohorts.

to.description: ISO-8601 UTC end of the window. Default: the newest order snapshot (`wallet`, `walls`, `order_stats`), now (`book_cohorts`). At most 30 days after `from` (`wallet`), 7 days (`walls`, `order_stats`, `book_cohorts`). Used by view: wallet, book_cohorts, walls, order_stats.

touch_bps.description: How close the other side of the book must have been, in basis points of the wall's price, when it was last seen, for `near_touch` to be true. Max 500. Used by view: walls.

view.description: What to read. `open`: the orders resting at one instant for a symbol and/or a wallet, each with its owner's labels. `wallet`: what became of one wallet's orders in a window (open, filled, canceled), newest first. `clusters`: one symbol's standing orders bucketed by price around the mid. `book`: one symbol's order book at one instant, price levels best first. `squeeze`: one perp's price ladder at one instant: resting book, stops and liquidations per bucket, and how much forced flow each bucket would take against its book. `book_cohorts`: which cohorts own the resting book near the mid, over time. `walls`: the large orders (walls) of a symbol and/or a wallet last seen in a window and what became of each: filled, pulled before any fill, or still open. `order_stats`: one wallet's walls in a window, in totals and per symbol: how many it pulled and filled. Default `open`.

wallet.description: `open`: one wallet's resting orders; `walls`: one wallet's walls. 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Used by view: open, walls.

title: Hyperliquid Orders
